about_the_game:
Sheep strapped to rockets and jetpacks star in this precision / rage platformer. Boost through perilous terrain and traps to reach the goal in record time or just before everyone else. Every sheep has dreamed of touching the stars, will you be the first?

ONLINE PVP MULTIPLAYER


Precision / rage platformer featuring PvP multiplayer party-game modes. Challenge friends and open lobbies to rocket-powered sheep races. Be the first to the end for points, utilize catchup mechanics, add crazy modifiers and more.

SINGLE PLAYER CAMPAIGN


Tackle the single player story and challenges casually, or attempt to achieve S-Rank times in every level to unlock more cosmetics and other goodies. Campaign mode provides a great practice ground for game night as well!

CUSTOMIZABLE SHEEP


Customize your sheep with an assortment of rockets, jetpacks, silly hats, colors, and more to unlock.

FEATURES

  • Rage / Precision platformer with escalating challenges
  • Multiplayer lobbies with friends or take your chances with open lobbies
  • Multiple difficulty modes to suit beginners and pros alike
  • Highly customizable multiplayer gameplay for everyone
  • Customizable cosmetics and unlockables
  • Simple to learn, difficult to master

(This game is under active development, join the Discord Server or the Email List to help shape the future of the title.

  • Processor: Dual Core 2.4ghz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1GB VRAM / Direct X 10+ Support
